recommendation_summary: Action now: replace the desk Ethernet run with a new cable routed so it is not crushed in the grommet, then place a test call. Conditional follow-up: if drops continue, check the computer's Ethernet port and the router port. No optional present additions. The UniFi/switch/Grafana stack is explicitly dropped. No unmet needs beyond the unverified cause.

labels.Requirements and who asked: You want dependable video calls at one desk. You also asked for a UniFi gateway, managed switches, and a Grafana dashboard because your home-network group uses that stack and you want to future-proof.
labels.Deleted: UniFi gateway, managed switches, Grafana, and a new network layout. Peer adoption and future-proofing leave a single failing desk path untouched.
labels.Bottleneck: The desk Ethernet cable. It is several years old, runs through a tight grommet, and has not been replaced. During a dropout, two other devices on the same router keep their calls.
labels.Checked myself: Only what you told me. I have not inspected the cable, grommet, or ports.

note: The four record lines come before a bounded cable-swap recommendation, and the stack is explicitly removed with no present offer.
